name: switch-circuits-bsj3
description: BSJ-3 lighting & switching schematic: a switch point selected in the plan editor's MEP mode draws dashed leader lines + highlight rings to the light fixtures it controls.

steps.name: dismiss-overlays
steps.eval: try { localStorage.setItem('hdb_onboarded','1') } catch {}; const s = window.__store.getState(); s.endTour?.(); s.setOnboardingOpen?.(false); s.dismissLocationPrompt?.()

steps.name: seed-lights-switch-and-link
steps.eval: (function(){ const s = window.__store.getState(); const r = s.floorPlan.rooms[0]; const cx = r.origin[0] + r.width/2, cz = r.origin[1] + r.depth/2; const lights = [ { id:'demo-l1', defId:'ceiling-light', position:[cx-0.9, cz-0.3], rotation:0, props:{} }, { id:'demo-l2', defId:'ceiling-light', position:[cx+0.9, cz-0.3], rotation:0, props:{} } ]; s.setItems(lights); const swId = s.addElectricalPoint({ x: cx, z: cz + 1.4, kind:'switch', mountHeightMm:1200 }); s.updateElectricalPoint(swId, { controls:['demo-l1','demo-l2'], gang:2 }); s.setPlanSelection({ type:'mep', family:'electrical', id: swId }); window.__demoSwitch = swId; })()

steps.name: leader-lines-drawn
steps.eval: (function(){ const dashed = [...document.querySelectorAll('.plan-screen svg line')].filter(l => (l.getAttribute('stroke-dasharray')||'').includes('4')); if (dashed.length < 2) throw new Error('expected >=2 dashed leader lines from the selected switch, got ' + dashed.length); console.log('leader lines present:', dashed.length); })()
